note: RBC Royal Bank: the Day to Day Banking account costs 4 dollars a month (the offer of a first year free for accounts opened by 8 December 2026, and the Value Program's rebate, aren't modelled). Read again 2026-10-30: Interac e-Transfers are free (up to 999 a month, not counted among the debits); spending in another currency with the RBC Virtual Visa Debit converts at 2.5% over RBC's benchmark rate; the account includes 12 debits a month, $1.25 each after, a per-item allowance the form doesn't hold (so no ATM figure is written). Not stated: overdraft, a returned payment, interest, another bank's machine, a transfer abroad, what opening asks.

sources.title: RBC Royal Bank, No Monthly Fee Account Offer
sources.said: No monthly fee for a year. After that, $4/month

sources.title: RBC Royal Bank, RBC Day to Day Banking: transactions and currency
sources.said: 12 Free Debits ... $1.25 each thereafter ... e-Transfer transactions are available with all Canadian dollar Banking Accounts and are not counted in the monthly total of debits. Limit of 999 free ... at an exchange rate that is 2.5% over a benchmark rate Royal Bank of Canada pays on the date of the conversion.
